about: I am a Ph.D. student in Data Science and Information Technology at Tsinghua University. My research focuses on embodied spatial intelligence: building an embodied brain that understands its environment, predicts future states, and acts to complete tasks.

Before my Ph.D., I received my M.Eng. and B.Eng. from South China University of Technology, where I worked on machine learning and optimization for energy systems. Beyond my primary research, I am also interested in quantitative investing.
